'''2016 MPC Matt Spear LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Spear]] at [[2016 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Player:''' [[Matt Spear]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 Match Play Championship]]
